text: 你看到一个貌似很强硬的女人。
source_text: 你看到一个貌似很强硬的女人。

text: Thank god you're here! Some crazy guy has Sinthia held hostage. He's threatening to kill her! You've got to help.
source_text: Thank god you're here! Some crazy guy has Sinthia held hostage. He's threatening to kill her! You've got to help.

text: 感谢上帝，你在这儿！有疯子抓住辛西娅当成人质。他威胁说要杀了她！你应该去帮帮她。
source_text: 感谢上帝，你在这儿！有疯子抓住辛西娅当成人质。他威胁说要杀了她！你应该去帮帮她。

text: Oh, geez, I hope you can do it. He's in her room. Help her!
source_text: Oh, geez, I hope you can do it. He's in her room. Help her!

text: 喔，见鬼，我希望你能搞定这件事。他就在她的房间里。帮帮她！
source_text: 喔，见鬼，我希望你能搞定这件事。他就在她的房间里。帮帮她！

text: You are an incredibly cold person. She could die without your help.
source_text: You are an incredibly cold person. She could die without your help.

text: 你的冷酷真是令人难以置信。没有你的帮助她会死的。
source_text: 你的冷酷真是令人难以置信。没有你的帮助她会死的。

text: All right, don't harp on me. I'll look into it.
source_text: All right, don't harp on me. I'll look into it.

text: 行了，别对着我唠唠叨叨。我去帮忙就是了。
source_text: 行了，别对着我唠唠叨叨。我去帮忙就是了。

text: 帮帮辛西娅吧。她有麻烦了。
source_text: 帮帮辛西娅吧。她有麻烦了。

text: Thank you for helping Sinthia. She's usually not a problem. You deserve a good night's sleep. On me. But don't ask for another freebie.
source_text: Thank you for helping Sinthia. She's usually not a problem. You deserve a good night's sleep. On me. But don't ask for another freebie.

text: 谢谢你帮了辛西娅一把。她很少惹麻烦的。加你额外的一宿当作谢礼。算我的。不过没什么其他的了。
source_text: 谢谢你帮了辛西娅一把。她很少惹麻烦的。加你额外的一宿当作谢礼。算我的。不过没什么其他的了。

text: 没问题。一号房间。跟我来。
source_text: 没问题。一号房间。跟我来。

text: Enjoy your stay. Don't be a pain.
source_text: Enjoy your stay. Don't be a pain.

text: You should have saved Sinthia. It's your fault she died. I hope you are happy with yourself.
source_text: You should have saved Sinthia. It's your fault she died. I hope you are happy with yourself.

text: 你本应救下辛西娅的。现在她死了，这都怪你。现在你开心了？
source_text: 你本应救下辛西娅的。现在她死了，这都怪你。现在你开心了？

text: Welcome to the Crash House. How can I help you, stranger?
source_text: Welcome to the Crash House. How can I help you, stranger?

text: 欢迎光临“躺躺屋”。需要点什么，陌生人？
source_text: 欢迎光临“躺躺屋”。需要点什么，陌生人？

text: I need a good night's sleep.
source_text: I need a good night's sleep.

text: Yeah, we serve your kind, too. It'll be $25 for the night. A week will cost you $150.
source_text: Yeah, we serve your kind, too. It'll be $25 for the night. A week will cost you $150.

text: 是的，你们这样的我们也提供服务。一晚上二十五块。一个礼拜一百五十块。
source_text: 是的，你们这样的我们也提供服务。一晚上二十五块。一个礼拜一百五十块。

text: Yeah, you too. Have a good day.
source_text: Yeah, you too. Have a good day.

text: Okay, thanks. Your room is room #1. Follow me. Don't be shooting any guns in here, okay?
source_text: Okay, thanks. Your room is room #1. Follow me. Don't be shooting any guns in here, okay?

text: 好的，谢谢。你的房间是一号。跟我来。别在这儿随便开枪，行吗？
source_text: 好的，谢谢。你的房间是一号。跟我来。别在这儿随便开枪，行吗？

text: You need some money before I can rent you a room.
source_text: You need some money before I can rent you a room.

text: Then you should try the Skum Pitt. I heard you can get a lot of water in your booze there.
source_text: Then you should try the Skum Pitt. I heard you can get a lot of water in your booze there.

text: 那你应该去斯卡姆·匹特酒吧。我听说那儿的酒里掺水不少。
source_text: 那你应该去斯卡姆·匹特酒吧。我听说那儿的酒里掺水不少。

text: I don't know about that, but I will rent you a room. It's a good place to rest and heal up. $25 for a day, or a week is $150. Most people go for the weekly rate. You should, if you ask me.
source_text: I don't know about that, but I will rent you a room. It's a good place to rest and heal up. $25 for a day, or a week is $150. Most people go for the weekly rate. You should, if you ask me.

text: 那些事情我不太清楚，不过我可以租给你个房间。这是个休息康复的好地方。二十五块一天，一个礼拜一百五十。大多数人都一租一个礼拜。愿意的话，你也能按这个房价租。
source_text: 那些事情我不太清楚，不过我可以租给你个房间。这是个休息康复的好地方。二十五块一天，一个礼拜一百五十。大多数人都一租一个礼拜。愿意的话，你也能按这个房价租。

text: I'm just a hotel manager, bub. Don't ask too much of me.
source_text: I'm just a hotel manager, bub. Don't ask too much of me.

text: 我只是个旅馆经理，小家伙。别问我这么多问题。
source_text: 我只是个旅馆经理，小家伙。别问我这么多问题。

text: Here's $50, tell me what you know.
source_text: Here's $50, tell me what you know.

text: 五十块，告诉我你所知道的。
source_text: 五十块，告诉我你所知道的。

text: I know you're $50 poorer. I don't do the gossip thing, okay? Come back if you want a room.
source_text: I know you're $50 poorer. I don't do the gossip thing, okay? Come back if you want a room.

text: 你这个连五十块也没有的穷鬼。我从来不说道别人，知道么？想要房间的时候再来吧。
source_text: 你这个连五十块也没有的穷鬼。我从来不说道别人，知道么？想要房间的时候再来吧。

text: What do you think I am? A fool? If you're gonna bribe me, have enough money.
source_text: What do you think I am? A fool? If you're gonna bribe me, have enough money.

text: 你把我想成什么了？一个傻瓜？想贿赂我的话，带上足够的钱再说。
source_text: 你把我想成什么了？一个傻瓜？想贿赂我的话，带上足够的钱再说。

text: Welcome back, what can I do for you?
source_text: Welcome back, what can I do for you?

text: 欢迎回来，有什么需要的？
source_text: 欢迎回来，有什么需要的？

text: I want to rent a room.
source_text: I want to rent a room.

text: You're already renting room #1 from me. Do you want me to show you where it is?
source_text: You're already renting room #1 from me. Do you want me to show you where it is?

text: 你已经从我这里租了一号房间。需要我领你去吗？
source_text: 你已经从我这里租了一号房间。需要我领你去吗？

text: And this is still your room. Have a good stay.
source_text: And this is still your room. Have a good stay.

text: 这仍旧是你的房间。住的愉快。
source_text: 这仍旧是你的房间。住的愉快。

text: You know the drill. One day is $25. One week is $150.
source_text: You know the drill. One day is $25. One week is $150.

text: 你知道价格的。一天二十五。一个礼拜一百五十块。
source_text: 你知道价格的。一天二十五。一个礼拜一百五十块。

text: Sure. It's $25 a day, or $150 for the entire week.
source_text: Sure. It's $25 a day, or $150 for the entire week.

text: 当然。一天二十五块，一整个礼拜的话一百五十块。
source_text: 当然。一天二十五块，一整个礼拜的话一百五十块。

text: Okay. Room #1 is yours. Have a nice stay.
source_text: Okay. Room #1 is yours. Have a nice stay.

text: 好了。一号房间是你的了。住的愉快。
source_text: 好了。一号房间是你的了。住的愉快。

text: I want to rent a room.
source_text: I want to rent a room.

text: I don't like your face. I don't think I'll be renting you a room.
source_text: I don't like your face. I don't think I'll be renting you a room.

text: 我不喜欢你的长相。不会租给你房间的。
source_text: 我不喜欢你的长相。不会租给你房间的。

text: I really need a place to stay.
source_text: I really need a place to stay.

text: 我真的需要个休息的地方。
source_text: 我真的需要个休息的地方。

text: Deal with it. Yes or no.
source_text: Deal with it. Yes or no.

text: Good. Here you go. Room #1. Have a nice night, check out time is 11 o' clock.
source_text: Good. Here you go. Room #1. Have a nice night, check out time is 11 o' clock.

text: 很好。这边走。一号房间。结账的时间是早上十一点，晚安。
source_text: 很好。这边走。一号房间。结账的时间是早上十一点，晚安。

text: Nah, wasn't me. Really it wasn't.
source_text: Nah, wasn't me. Really it wasn't.

text: Get out! You're too dumb to realize what you did, but my life is hell now!
source_text: Get out! You're too dumb to realize what you did, but my life is hell now!

text: 滚！你倒是蠢得不知道自己干了什么，可我的生活现在却一团糟！
source_text: 滚！你倒是蠢得不知道自己干了什么，可我的生活现在却一团糟！

text: You son of a bitch. I can't believe you killed him. He was a good man, and now I get all sorts of hell . . . get out, and don't come back.
source_text: You son of a bitch. I can't believe you killed him. He was a good man, and now I get all sorts of hell . . . get out, and don't come back.

text: 你这个婊子养的。我简直不能相信你居然杀了他。他是个好人，现在我他妈的一团糟……滚吧，别再回来了。
source_text: 你这个婊子养的。我简直不能相信你居然杀了他。他是个好人，现在我他妈的一团糟……滚吧，别再回来了。

text: Yeah, whatever you say, but that's not what I heard. You'd better behave around here, or I'll get out ol' Betsy and ram some buckshot up your ass.
source_text: Yeah, whatever you say, but that's not what I heard. You'd better behave around here, or I'll get out ol' Betsy and ram some buckshot up your ass.

text: 是啊，随便你怎么说，但我听说的可不是这样。你最好小心点，不然我会用我的枪轰掉你的屁股。
source_text: 是啊，随便你怎么说，但我听说的可不是这样。你最好小心点，不然我会用我的枪轰掉你的屁股。

text: It's late. I hope you aren't wasting my time.
source_text: It's late. I hope you aren't wasting my time.

text: 已经很晚了。我希望你不是在浪费我的时间。
source_text: 已经很晚了。我希望你不是在浪费我的时间。

text: Hey! That fridge is for customers only!
source_text: Hey! That fridge is for customers only!

text: 喂！那冰箱是专门给顾客用的！
source_text: 喂！那冰箱是专门给顾客用的！

text: Marcelles charges in to confront the raider!
source_text: Marcelles charges in to confront the raider!
